def factor_vwap_sma_divergence(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    d = 20
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    vwap = (close * volume).rolling(window=d, min_periods=d).sum() / volume.rolling(window=d, min_periods=d).sum()
    sma = close.rolling(window=d, min_periods=d).mean()
    factor = (vwap - sma) / close
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0)
    factor.name = "factor_vwap_sma_divergence"
    return factor
description: Computes divergence between volume-weighted average price (VWAP) and simple moving average (SMA) over a 20-day window. When VWAP > SMA, it indicates that high-volume days drove prices above the average, implying bullish coherence; when VWAP < SMA, high-volume days were at lower prices, implying bearish coherence. Normalized by current close for stationarity.
